comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Primarily a rural Alaska electric utility with hydro generation; telecom is secondary, so business mix differs.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Operates fiber, cable broadband and tower leasing for consumers, businesses and carriers; closely overlapping network operator, though with mobile wireless.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Diversified holding company dominated by billboards and insurance; fiber broadband is only a small part.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Alaska-focused integrated carrier with significant wireless; GCI Liberty is also a holding entity, less comparable to Mid-Atlantic fiber operator.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: TDS Telecom sells fiber and cable broadband, video and voice to residential and business customers in smaller markets, plus towers.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Owns fiber networks selling consumer and business broadband plus wholesale fiber transport to carriers, matching Shentel's fiber model.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Satellite broadband and defense equipment manufacturer; different technology, customers and revenue mix from terrestrial fiber operator.
